newsitem.title: CANADA: Metallica in Chile joint venture with BHP.
newsitem.headline: Metallica in Chile joint venture with BHP.

text.p: Metallica Resources Inc said on Thursday it plans to form a joint venture with a Chilean subsidiary of Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd to explore and possibly develop the La Fortuna gold-copper project in north-central Chile.

Metallica said it has entered into a letter of intent to form the joint venture with Minera BHP de Chile. The deal lets Metallica earn a 50 percent if it invests a total of US$1.3 million in exploration over the next three years, Metallica said.
BHP has already explored some of the property for copper from 1992 to 1994.
Metallica said it believes the property has potential for gold mineralization in areas not sufficiently explored.

On Wednesday, Metallica said it had increased its proven and probable reserves at its Cerro San Pedro gold-silver heap leach project in Mexico to 2.26 million ounces of gold equivalent, up from previous estimates of 1.67 million ounces.
